=== Mod-a first selects the item's content
--- given
- abc‸
  - d
--- when key Mod-a
--- then
- ⟨abc⟩
  - d

=== Mod-a then selects the item with its subtree
--- given
- ⟨abc⟩
  - d
--- when key Mod-a
--- then
- ⟨abc
  - d⟩

=== Mod-a then selects the whole list
--- given
- x
- ⟨abc
  - d⟩
--- when key Mod-a
--- then
⟨- x
- abc
  - d⟩

=== Mod-a on the whole list passes to the editor
--- given
⟨- x
- abc
  - d⟩
--- when key Mod-a
--- then passthrough
⟨- x
- abc
  - d⟩

=== Mod-a skips the subtree rung on an item without children
--- given
- x
- ⟨abc⟩
--- when key Mod-a
--- then
⟨- x
- abc⟩

=== Mod-a content rung covers the notes lines
--- given
- ab‸c
  note
--- when key Mod-a
--- then
- ⟨abc
  note⟩

=== Mod-a with the anchor outside the list passes to the editor
--- given
a paragraph
⟨- a⟩
--- when key Mod-a
--- then passthrough
a paragraph
⟨- a⟩

=== Mod-a passes to the editor when switched off
--- given selectall=off
- abc‸
--- when key Mod-a
--- then passthrough
- abc‸

=== Mod-a content starts after the task box
--- given
- [ ] ab‸
--- when key Mod-a
--- then
- [ ] ⟨ab⟩

=== Mod-a content starts after the bullet when the box counts as content
--- given stick=bullet-only
- [ ] ab‸
--- when key Mod-a
--- then
- ⟨[ ] ab⟩

=== Mod-a from a partial selection inside the item selects the content first
--- given
- a⟨b⟩c
  - d
--- when key Mod-a
--- then
- ⟨abc⟩
  - d
